'''Yoda's ''Acclamator''-class transport''' was an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]{{'s}} [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] was marked with gold trim to designate it as his personal [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], a specially configured troop transport to lead operations during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
